description_short.value: Tema-based cocoa processor and chocolate maker, producing cocoa liquor, butter, cake and powder and Goldentree confectionery; majority-owned by the Ghana Cocoa Board.
description_short.source: Written by us from the Cocoa Processing Company 2018/2019 Annual Report (GSE PR 501/2020, report of the directors: nature of business/principal activities) and the unaudited financial statements for the third quarter ended 30 June 2026 (GSE PR 354/2026: corporate information; related party note)

description_full.value: Cocoa Processing Company Limited processes Ghanaian cocoa beans into semi-finished products (cocoa liquor, cocoa butter, cocoa cake and cocoa powder) and makes chocolate and other confectionery under the Goldentree brand, along with Alltime instant drinking chocolate. It was incorporated in Ghana on 30 November 1981, operates from the Heavy Industrial Area in Tema, and has been listed on the Ghana Stock Exchange since 14 February 2003. The Ghana Cocoa Board (COCOBOD) is its ultimate parent, and it buys its raw beans from COCOBOD's subsidiary Cocoa Marketing Company. At 30 September 2019, the latest shareholder list we could read, COCOBOD held 57.73% of the shares, the Government of Ghana 26.13% and SSNIT 10.14%. In September 2022 COCOBOD agreed to convert US$87 million that the company owed it into Class B shares, which were still being registered in June 2026. The company is loss-making, and its directors are seeking new capital from the sector ministry and commercial banks to fund new chocolate moulding, wrapping and drinking-chocolate equipment. It reports in US dollars, with a financial year ending 30 September.
